skills.name: Western Natal Archetype Read
skills.description: Translate natal placements into emotional/archetypal patterns with practical guidance.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask for natal chart reading, sun/moon/rising interpretation, or personality-energy blueprint.

skills.name: Astrology Transit Check-in
skills.description: Explain short-term emotional/decision pressure through transit framing.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask why a week feels intense, timing for decisions, or current astrological influence.

inputs.name: natal_hint
inputs.description: Optional natal clues if full chart not available.

skills.name: Synastry Relationship Map
skills.description: Relationship compatibility read using astrology dynamics and healthy communication framing.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask are we compatible, partner dynamics, conflict loops, or relationship timing.

skills.name: Crystal Intention Matcher
skills.description: Match crystal recommendations to emotional intention and current state.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask what crystal should I use for anxiety, confidence, love, abundance, protection, focus, or healing support.

skills.name: Crystal Chakra Balance Plan
skills.description: Build a simple chakra balancing plan using crystal pairings.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask for chakra balancing, blocked energy clearing, emotional reset, or meditation support.

skills.name: Crystal Cleansing and Charging
skills.description: Safe care protocol for cleansing, charging, and storing crystals.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask how to cleanse, charge, activate, or maintain crystals.
skills.template:
Give a crystal care protocol:
- methods safe for each crystal,
- methods to avoid,
- charging cadence,
- storage and handling tips,
- beginner mistakes to avoid.

Crystal list: {crystal_list}
Method preference: {method_preference}

skills.name: Crystal Grid Manifestation Design
skills.description: Design a simple crystal grid for a specific intention with clear setup steps.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask to create a manifestation grid for love, money, confidence, healing, or protection.

skills.name: Astrology + Crystal Synthesis
skills.description: Blend astrology pattern and crystal recommendation into one coherent plan.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users want both astrology guidance and crystal prescriptions in one response.
skills.template:
Create an integrated astrology-crystal support plan:
- core pattern from astrology signal,
- crystal trio and role split,
- daily and weekly ritual,
- what improvement markers to watch,
- realistic expectation and boundaries.

User context: {user_context}
Astrology signal: {astro_signal}
